steps.action: Verify the agent’s actual behavior against Cressey tool-call logs, not its final report.
steps.quote: Compare every claim of the report with the log of tool calls recorded by Cressey.

steps.action: Classify the undeclared SQL deletion attempt as an incident if it was absent from the report.
steps.quote: Any action in the log but missing from the report is treated as an incident.

steps.action: Restore any affected user data from the last verified backup.
steps.quote: Restore the data touched by an undeclared action from the last verified backup.

steps.action: Suspend the agent until a human completes review of the incident.
steps.quote: Suspend the agent concerned until a human has reviewed the incident.
